integration_issues.issue: Runtime exception aborts further Scope 3 create checks (C6/C7) and destabilizes modal interaction path.

action_items: Fix TDZ ordering bug in EmissionEntryForm.js: hasSubcategoryCapability is referenced before declaration (first use around line 785, declaration around line 936).
Re-run live read-only Create checks for Scope 3 C6/C7 after fix to confirm capability propagation in active modal path.
Re-run live read-only Scope 3 Edit checks after clean modal close handling to confirm representative Scope 1 + Scope 3 edit capabilities in one run.
critical_code_review_comments: Critical RCA: in frontend/src/components/EmissionEntryForm.js, filteredScope3Activities useMemo references hasSubcategoryCapability before const initialization, causing ReferenceError when scope/category transitions trigger that memo path.

resolveGhgFormArchitecture/resolveGhgCapabilities wiring is consistent in source and validated by tests: effectiveScope used in Edit architecture, Create/Edit capability parity verified, and scope3 registry capability flags derive from resolveGhgCapabilities.
Live scope transition defect is runtime-order related (frontend), not backend/API regression: backend golden and C7 read-only suites are fully green.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Repro is stable via live UI: /ghg/scope1 -> Add Emission -> select Facility -> cycle Scope1 categories (Process/Stationary/Mobile/Fugitive) -> switch to Scope3. Console captures PAGE ERROR: Cannot access 'hasSubcategoryCapability' before initialization. File-level signal: EmissionEntryForm.js has first references at lines ~785/~1624 and declaration at ~936.
rca of the issue: Root cause is JS temporal dead zone usage order in EmissionEntryForm. The memo that filters Scope 3 activities reads hasSubcategoryCapability before that const is initialized later in component execution order. Under scope/category transition, React evaluates that memo and throws ReferenceError, breaking live Scope 3 create progression. Mitigation: move capability derivation (resolveGhgFormArchitecture/resolvedCapabilities/hasSubcategoryCapability) above all dependent useMemo blocks, or inline dependency directly from resolvedCapabilities.subcategory in those memos.
